content.name: Steady Aim
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this feature only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use it, your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is 0 until the end of the current turn.
